notes: The park refuted the premise: no verdict is lost. `failed` is only ever set true, so `expected undefined` is the wave never walling, and `<worktree>/.git` is composed only by this test file. On win32 the arming does not arm, teardown deletes the worktree, and the evidence read ENOENTs on the path it deleted. No tests[]: the whole diff is the file carrying them.
